AbstractText.Label: CONTEXT
AbstractText.content: Circulating MicroRNAs (miRNAs) are emerging as novel biomarkers for tumour.

AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: Evaluate the diagnostic potential of plasma miR-200b-3p in oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC).

AbstractText.Label: MATERIALS AND METHODS
AbstractText.content: miR-200b-3p was detected by qRT-PCR in paired pre-operative and post-operative plasmas from 80 OSCC patients and 80 healthy controls.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: Plasma miR-200b-3p was significantly upregulated in OSCC, and it was higher in WHO II/III grade than WHO I grade. The AUC of miR-200b-3p for OSCC was 0.9173. miR-200b-3p was significantly downregulated after surgery. High miR-200b-3p expression was associated with poor prognosis.

AbstractText.Label: DISCUSSION AND CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: Plasma miR-200b-3p could be a potential diagnostic biomarker for OSCC.
